about.title: About us
about.text:
Blue Way is a Saudi establishment based in Al-Masane district, Riyadh, delivering technical and field services across telecom and power — from maintaining and operating electrical generators and telecom tower fuel tanks, to laying telecom and fiber optic cables, and supplying industrial oils.

Technical and field works for telecom companies' projects
Generator maintenance, operation and inspection
Telecom and fiber optic cable installation
Industrial oil supply and sales
